title: Candy
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of 20 pull-ups, 40 push-ups and 60 squats for time, no rest built in. Essentially Barbara without the sit-ups or the rest, so it runs as one continuous 25 to 40 minute grind. Scale by cutting reps per round.
